Let the Wookiee win.|Han Solo and [[C-3PO]]|}} '''Wookiees''', known in their own language of [[Shyriiwook]] as "'''the People of the Trees'''," were a [[species]] of tall, [[hair]]y [[humanoid]]s that were native to the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. A notable member of this species was the warrior [[Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo]]'s best friend and co-[[pilot]], who played a vital role in the [[Clone Wars]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]], the [[Galactic Civil War]] by aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Emperor|Galactic Empire]], and the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. They were quite strong, and were known to rip people's arms out of their sockets when provoked. Though being from a temperate planet known for its [[swamp]]s and [[forest]]s, Wookiees were perfectly comfortable on icy worlds like [[Ilum]] and [[Hoth]], not requiring any additional protective [[clothing]], i.e. [[glove]]s or [[boot]]s. ==Biology and appearance== {{Quote|Big. Covered in fur. Strong.|[[Beru Whitesun Lars]] describes a Wookiee|[[Star Wars (2015) 20|''Star Wars'' (2015) 20]]}} [[File:Gungi-TCWs5BR1.png|thumb|left|180px|Gungi, a Wookiee youngling in the Jedi Order]] Wookiees were a tall [[species]] of furry humanoids from the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], who could grow to a height of nearly three [[meter]]s.{{Databank|wookiee|Wookiee}} They were covered from head to toe in a thick, shaggy coat of [[hair]] with [[water]]-shedding properties that notably came in [[Color|shades]] of brown, black, gray, and white. The species had two [[Gender|sexes]], female and male. The latter grew long beards in adult life.''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' The average male weighed 150 [[kilogram]]s while the average female weighed 100 kilograms. The Wookiees' [[eye]] [[color]] ranged from blue to brown. Wookiees were big eaters, with the average adult requiring 3,500-6,000 calories a [[Standard day|day]] of [[Foodstuff|food]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' Their [[diet]] consisted of wild [[plant]]s, [[Berry|berries]], [[meat]], and spices. They preferred their spices to be hot. While Wookiees did not like eating [[blosphi extract]], it provided them with enough nutrition to survive.''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'' The "[[Wookiee flu]]" was a sickness that affected Wookiees. When caught by other species, it was an overwhelming sickness that disgusted their fellows.''[[Doctor Aphra: An Audiobook Original]]'' The literary collective term for Wookiees was a grove of Wookiees.''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]'' Many of their kind were known to understand Galactic Basic but were unable to speak it due to their species' vocal structure.[[Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine 4|''Star Wars Jedi Master Magazine'' 4]] [[File:WookieeAnatomyDiagram-TSotW.png|thumb|right|300px|Wookiee anatomy diagram]] Wookiees had extendable claws which they used for climbing; using them for anything else violated the [[Wookiee honor code]].''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel]]'' Despite their fearsome appearance and volatile temperament, Wookiees were regarded as intelligent, sophisticated, loyal and trusting. When angered, Wookiees were known to descend into a berserker rage. Wookiees had an average lifespan of 400 [[standard year]]s, and they appeared not to age over a span of fifty [[Standard year|years]].{{Film|VII}} Their lifespans dramatically decreased due to the harsh working conditions in the [[spice]] [[Mining|mines]] of [[Kessel]]. During their prime growing years, Wookiees were often hungry, forcing them to eat whenever they could.''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' One Wookiee, [[Lohgarra]], lived healthily for [[Standard century|centuries]]—the only distinction being her white fur. They could learn to understand other [[language]]s, like [[Galactic Basic Standard]], but they were physically unable to speak them''[[Sabine My Rebel Sketchbook]]'' due to their strange vocal chords that prevented them from speaking verbal languages. To those who had not learned to understand [[Shyriiwook]], the Wookiee language, it appeared they spoke in a series of growls and purrs. Although a rare phenomenon, [[Force-sensitive]] Wookiees were possible, and some joined the ranks of the [[Jedi]], becoming a source of great pride for their people.{{TCW|A Test of Strength}} Such Wookiees included the [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelnacca]],{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} Jedi Master [[Arkoff]],[[The High Republic: The Edge of Balance, Vol. 1|''The High Republic: The Edge of Balance'', Vol. 1]] [[Jedi Knight]] [[Burryaga Agaburry]],''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' Jedi Master [[Tyvokka]],''[[Star Wars Workbook: 2nd Grade Reading]]'' and the [[Jedi Initiate|youngling]] [[Gungi]]. ==History== ===The Clone Wars=== [[File:WookieeWarriorsKashyyykDefenders-2025RepUnit.png|thumb|right|300px|Wookiee warriors defended their homeworld against Separatist invaders.]] {{Quote|Go, I will. Good relations with the Wookiees, I have.|Jedi Master Yoda|{{Film|III}}}} Wookiees originated on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[forest]] planet of Kashyyyk. In the ancient past, they invented and crafted weapons that fired poisoned darts and arrows.''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' During the [[Clone Wars]] and the reign of [[King]] [[Grakchawwaa]],''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''—Crew Member: "Alrrark" the Wookiees remained fiercely loyal to the [[Galactic Republic]] and fought alongside them in several [[star system]]s. Towards the end of the conflict, Wookiee forces also defended their [[homeworld]] from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk|invasion]] with the help of Galactic Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic|forces]] led by [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]], who had good relations with them. ===Age of the Empire=== {{Quote|Kashyyyk, l-look, things are really bad down there. The - the Empire's muscling in on those Wookiees big time.|Greez Dritus talking about the Empire's exploitation of Wookiees|''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''}} At the end of the Clone Wars, numerous Wookiees were slaughtered by the [[clone trooper]]s they allied with in the ensuing chaos of the anti-Jedi [[Order 66]], and soon after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], their homeworld of Kashyyyk was [[blockade]]d by the Empire. The softening and repeal of anti-[[slavery]] laws ultimately led to the Empire classifying the Wookiees as non-sentient.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' The Empire enslaved the Wookiees not because they were a meaningful threat to the Empire but because their massive, robust physiology allowed them to work long and hard in extreme conditions.''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' [[File:Wookiee_Warriors_Unit_Expansion_art.png|thumb|left|200px|A pair of Wookiees rush into battle wielding [[ryyk blade]]s]] As a result, many Wookiees were enslaved and made to build much of the Imperial war machine, sent to be worked to [[death]] in the dangerous [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of the planet [[Kessel]], or on construction sites such as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], though a number escaped this fate.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] Numerous Wookiees were bred for use in medical experimentation, and some were used as playthings for [[Grand Moff]] [[Lozen Tolruck]], Imperial governor of Kashyyyk, who occasionally hunted live Wookiees for sport. To keep them in line, all of the Wookiees on Kashyyyk were fitted with [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] that caused them great pain if activated. The Empire also quickly learned the most efficient way of preventing any wide-scale uprisings was by threatening clan and family members, particularly the younglings. Normally, a Wookiee would quite willingly rip a stormtrooper limb from limb regardless of their own safety, but could not bear to see other Wookiees subjected to the agony instead. Despite these grave circumstances for their race, the Wookiees nonetheless found ways to help others. In the early days of the Empire, the Outer Rim planet of [[Lasan]], home to the [[Lasat]], was brutally sacked and devastated by the Empire for daring to question the new regime. Unable to stand by and watch, many Wookiees went to Lasan and fought the Empire with weapons forged from the [[wroshyr]] trees of their homeworld, in many cases giving their own lives to save the Lasats. Because of their actions, a few Lasats (including [[Garazeb Orrelios]]) were able to escape the genocide and survive in the wider galaxy. [[File:Choyyssyk-TSotW.png|thumb|right|300px|Surviving Jedi Cal Kestis helped the Partisans free Wookiees from an Imperial refinery.]] In [[14 BBY]], Wookiees who were being held prisoner by the Empire and forced to work at an Imperial refinery in Kashyyyk, were freed by the [[Partisans]] led by [[Saw Gerrera]] and the Jedi Padawan [[Cal Kestis]], who joined them during the attack on the refinery. Kestis went to Kashyyyk in search of [[Tarfful]], a Wookiee chieftain he believed might have information that could be useful in his [[Secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order|mission]] to rebuild the [[Jedi Order]]. Kestis left the world while the Partisans searched for Tarfful and returned when he was informed they had found him. Tarfful told Kestis to search the top of the [[Origin Tree]], where he figured out where to go. [[File:WookieeTrio-MtHChewbacca.png|thumb|left|250px|Enslaved Wookiees forced to work in the spice mines of Kessel]] During the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], the-then [[Commodore]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Eli N. Vanto|Eli Vanto]] discovered evidence that the Empire was transporting enslaved Wookiees after responding to a distress transmission from the troop transport ''[[Sempre]]''. The Wookiee slaves were [[Attack on the Sempre|liberated]] by a task force consisting of the frigate ''[[Castilus]]'' and two squadrons of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]]s, which then [[Battle at Lansend Twenty-Six|attacked]] the space station [[Lansend Twenty-Six]], where more Wookiee slaves were held. Thrawn commanded the operation to reinforce Baklek Base and forced the insurgents to surrender. When Vanto objected to slavery, Thrawn tried to rationalize the Empire's enslavement of Wookiees.[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] About fourteen years after the establishment of the Empire, the [[212th Attack Battalion]] led by [[General]] [[Kahdah]] quelled a Wookiee [[Wookiee revolt|revolt]] on Kashyyyk. Civilian travel to the planet was restricted and access was granted only for official government business.{{HoloNetNewsTumblr|post/92683360686/holonet-news-report-wookiee-revolt-quelled-on|Report: Wookiee Revolt Quelled on Kashyyyk|int=HoloNet News Report: Wookiee Revolt Quelled on Kashyyyk}} Shortly later, the Empire [[transport]]ed several captives including [[Wullffwarro]] and his son [[Kitwarr]] to the [[spice]] [[Mining|mines]] of Kessel. The [[Spectres]], a rebel cell based on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of Lothal, [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescued]] the [[prisoner]]s and escaped Kessel.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' ===Joining the Rebellion=== {{Quote|Would somebody get this big walking carpet out of my way?|Princess Leia referring to Chewbacca|audio=WalkingCarpet.flac|}} [[File:Tenacity_SWL.png|thumb|right|300px|Wookiees were known for their tenacity in battle.]] During the [[Galactic Civil War]], several Wookiees, including [[Chewbacca]] and [[Lohgarra]], fought for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and its successor government, the [[New Republic]]. [[5 BBY|One year]] following the [[Battle of Endor]], the Wookiee homeworld had become an Imperial remnant known as [[Imperial territory G5-623]] led by Grand Moff Tolruck. Kashyyyk was later [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberated]] by the [[New Republic Defense Force|New Republic forces]]. Working with a group of rebels led by [[Han Solo]] and Chewbacca, the former Imperial loyalty officer [[Sinjir Rath Velus]], used a hyperspace transceiver to neutralize Tolruck's inhibitor chips. This enabled the Wookiees to rise up en-masse against the Imperial occupiers and take their well-earned revenge, with Grand Moff Tolruck himself being killed by his personal slave, [[Subject 6391-A|Cracktooth]]. The Imperial forces attempted to orbital bombard Kashyyyk but were defeated by a New Republic fleet led by [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar|Ackbar]]. Wookiee and New Republic forces then conducted mopping-up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Kashyyyk. During one of these skirmishes, Chewbacca reunited with his son, [[Lumpawaroo]], who had escaped from a slave labor camp run by [[Commandant]] [[Dessard]].''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' [[File:Krrsantan-BHUSC.png|thumb|left|200px|Black Krrsantan, a Wookiee bounty hunter active during the New Republic era]] ===New Republic era=== During the [[New Republic era]], Kashyyyk's forests including the Black Forest grew back. Many Wookiees including Chewbacca and Chief [[Karasshki]] lived in villages. About [[7 ABY|two years]] after the [[Battle of Jakku]], the rogue [[Pau'an]] surgeon [[Fyzen Gor]] began kidnapping and killing Wookiee [[youngling]]s to use as spare parts for his [[droid]] followers, the [[Original Dozen]]. Due to his shadowy appearance, he earned the nickname the "Long Man." Chewbacca agreed to help [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] retrieve the [[Phylanx Redux Transmitter]] in return recovering the limbs of the murdered Wookiees for funeral rites.''[[Last Shot]]'' ==Society and culture== {{Quote|A Wookiee! Rare you are to the Jedi. Proud, your people must be.|Professor [[Huyang]] to Gungi|}} [[File:WookieeNight.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Wookiee buildings blended with their environment.]] The name for their species was known to translate from Shyriiwook into [[Galactic Basic Standard]]''[[Star Wars Mania]]'' literally as "the People of the Trees". Living in a great harmony with the nature of Kashyyyk,{{InsiderCite|216|Forces of Nature: The Wild Spaces and Wilder Creatures of the Star Wars Galaxy|Forces of Nature: The Wild Spaces and Wilder Creatures of the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy}} the Wookiees placed great value upon the wroshyr trees of their home planet; they considered the mighty trees the true owners of the land, themselves merely coexisting with them, and would consult them before every battle by bowing their heads against their wood to listen to their wisdom.{{TBB|Tribe}} Wookiees were expert craftsmen who blended off-world technology like [[blaster]]s and [[lightsaber]]s with traditional materials such as [[wood]], precious [[stone]]s, and [[metal]]s. Most Wookiees carried [[bowcaster]]s as weaponry, which were handcrafted.[[Chewbacca's bowcaster]] broke Wookiee tradition due to its automatic cocking system. Wookiees believed that seeing a [[can-cell]] brought good luck, and Wookiees often kept them as pets. The Wookiee people by and large hated [[Trandoshan]]s, great [[Hunting|hunters]]{{Databank|tarfful|Tarfful}} who turned their talents against the Wookiees and hunted them.{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}} The highest way a Wookiee could compliment someone was to groom them. Wookiees were not known to be subtle.''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' In Wookiee society, loyalty and courage were valued as sacrosanct tenets. It was typical for Wookiees to value honor and friendship above all else. It was considerably rare to find Wookiees with criminal tendencies.[[Jedi Knights 5|''Jedi Knights'' 5]] When male Wookiees turned 12 years old, they would undergo initiation rituals to enter adulthood. Wookiees spoke three [[language]]s: [[Shyriiwook]], [[Thykarann]], and [[Xaczik]]. Shyriiwook had 150 words for "wood" but no word for "[[artist]]" because Wookiees viewed their carving skills as a survival skill and not a talent.{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-wookiees|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Wookiees}} ==Wookiees in the galaxy== {{Quote|Wookiees stand out in a crowd.|Lando Calrissian|{{Film|IX}}}} [[File:Notorious_Scoundrels_SWL.png|thumb|left|250px|Chewbacca and Han Solo were famous smugglers-turned-Rebel heroes.]] Wookiees were referred to as [[mongrel]]s by others.''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' Notable Wookiees included Chewbacca, the [[navigator]] and long-time companion of Han Solo. Other noteworthy Wookiees included the [[chief]] and general [[Tarfful]] (who fought alongside Master Yoda during the Battle of Kashyyyk), the warrior Wullffwarro, and his son Kitwarr. Force-sensitive Wookiees included the Jedi Master Arkoff,Jedi Master [[Kelnacca]], and Jedi Padawan Burryaga Agaburry, all of whom lived in the [[High Republic Era]], as well as the Jedi [[youngling]] Gungi, who lived during the Clone Wars. During the Age of the Empire, [[Krrsantan]] was a Wookiee who worked as a [[bounty hunter]] for both [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. The first [[Unidentified Wookiee (Leia Organa)|Wookiee]] Leia Organa ever met was a guest at one of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]]'s state dinners, with the Wookiee leaving an impression on the young Leia.[[Hyperspace Stories 2|''Hyperspace Stories'' 2]] [[Drokkatta]] was a Wookiee who served in the [[Coruscant rebel cell]].{{SWIA|set=Heart of the Empire}} The Wookiee [[Greybok]] played an important role in turning the tide of the [[Battle on Sevarcos]] by freeing several [[rancor]]s, which rampaged the Imperial lines. He later took part in Han Solo and Chewbacca's campaign to liberate Kashyyyk. While serving as a [[senator]] in the New Republic's [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]], Leia Organa once saw two Wookiee commuters in front of her on an [[automated sidewalk]] at the [[New Republic senatorial complex]] on [[Hosnian Prime]].[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] ==Behind the scenes== The word "Wookiee" originated in [[George Lucas]]'s first movie, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']], in a line ad-libbed by actor [[Wikipedia:Terry McGovern (actor)|Terry McGovern]]: "I think I just ran over a Wookiee."{{Instagram|username=starwars|url=p/BG7JzlVM_dc|name=Star Wars|date=21-06-2016|archiveurl=https://archive.is/evF41}} A Wookiee later appeared through Chewbacca in the first [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']] film. In the [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] of the script for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], Wookiees (spelt "Wookees") inhabit [[Yavin 4|Yavin]] and fly some of the starfighters in the [[Battle of Yavin]].''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' According to {{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-8-things-you-might-not-know-about-wookiees|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Wookiees}}, in early drafts of the script for {{Film|VI}}, the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] was to be built in [[orbit]] around Kashyyyk and the construction would be done by Wookiee laborers, but ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]'' and ''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' contradict this, instead saying that [[Ewok]]s and the [[Endor|forest moon of Endor]] were present in [[George Lucas]]'s earliest notes and scripts for ''Return of the Jedi'' while Kashyyyk and Wookiees other than Chewbacca were never present.''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' The Wookiees also appeared in the non-canon ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' episode "[[Peril on Kashyyyk]]," which premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[June 27]], [[2016]]. In the episode, the scavenging [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]] family helps Chief [[Attiburra]] rescue his son [[Tantarra]] from a Trandoshan island fortress.{{FreemakerAdventures|Peril on Kashyyyk}}
